feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 November 2026 10:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 22 November 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic and high pressure in the Norwegian Sea extending a ridge over the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

East or southeast, veering south or southeast overnight, 4 or 5, increasing force 6 in the west of the area tomorrow morning, further increasing 5 or 6 in all waters later in the day and increasing occasionally 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy rain in the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 6 or 7, increasing occasionally gale 8 overnight into Tuesday, slowly decreasing 5 to 7, then becoming cyclonic 3 to 5 in the southwest of the area later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Patchy rain becoming widespread on Tuesday and heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain area.
